intro: A chill runs through the clearing. Something in the shadows is... giggling?
speaker: Gengar
introDialogue: Kekekeke... look at you. Barely standing. Wounds everywhere. Tell me, trainer...$Do you LIKE being on the brink of death?$Kekeke... I do. It's where all the interesting things happen.$My little friend here has lived on that brink its whole life. Beat it, and one of yours can learn what it knows.
title: Brink of Death
description: The Gengar's wager: defeat its Shedinja, and one of your Pokémon may embrace the grave's power — the Ghost type, and one of three spectral fates chosen by... well, by fate.

1.label: Accept the Wager
1.tooltip:
(+) Pledge a Pokémon; win to grant it the Ghost type and a random spectral ability
(-) Your battered party must defeat the Shedinja
1.selected: Kekekeke... choose your volunteer. My friend does so love company on the brink.

2.label: Back Away Slowly
2.selected: Kekeke... yes, run along. The brink will still be here next time.$It always is.

outro: The Gengar melts into the shadows, still snickering. The chill lingers a moment longer than it should.
